description: Every Stellar account the Blocksmiths control. Public keys, not secrets. An agent owned by any of these is NEVER counted as externally operated (SOW 6.3), and GET /api/ecosystem/adoption lists it under `excluded` with the role below. Add a wallet here the moment the team creates one; leaving it out would count our own agent as someone else's. Validated at boot: every address must be a valid G-strkey, with no duplicates.
